name: synthesis-window-upper
description: The synthesis window at code 2 (108 B), the format's strongest point against size-matched WebP. Split from synthesis-window.json rather than added as extra arms because guards, the dE00 delta and the paired CI are all computed against the FIRST row: mixing tiers in one config would compare a 108-byte arm to a 32-byte incumbent and make the tightest instrument in the harness meaningless. Same pattern as scalefactor-bands / scalefactor-bands-t1. This is the tier where a regression costs the most -- README.md 14.1 rests the format's positioning claim on it -- and, per EXPERIMENTS.md 7.14, ringing climbs monotonically with tier while every fidelity metric improves, so it is also where the window has the most to suppress.
